entries.figma_prompt: Single image, no panels, the picture fills the whole vertical frame. Pre-dawn sidewalk in the Philippines: a lean young Filipino man about twenty, slim youthful face, black hair slicked back into a small black topknot, plain collarless grey t-shirt, jeans, bare neck with no necklace, BARE CLEAN FOREARMS WITH NO TATTOOS on both arms, exactly one red handkerchief tied on his left wrist, the same light-skinned Indio as in the episode's other present-day shots, barefoot, crouching to the eye level of a thin barefoot Filipino street boy about ten in an oversized faded t-shirt who stands beside him, forearms resting on his knees, asking him something gently. No dog, no animals.
